instruction: Make all placeholder brackets [] bold in the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making text within brackets bold. Evaluator searches for text containing '[' or ']' and checks if those text spans have bold formatting. Partial credit given based on percentage of brackets that are bold.
metadata.verification_note: Evaluator uses custom ODT XML parsing to check formatting properties. No manual calculation needed for these formatting checks.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts bold formatting state from ODT XML structure
Getter correctly counts total brackets ([, ]) and bold brackets separately by parsing text:span elements and checking fo:font-weight property
Metric correctly calculates ratio (brackets_bold / total_brackets) and compares to threshold
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter: 'expected.get('min_threshold', 1.0)' - proper handling for type='rule'
Edge case handled: returns 1.0 when total_brackets == 0 (vacuously true)
Postconfig appropriately activates window and saves file (Ctrl+S) so getter can read updated ODT state
Instruction coverage complete: evaluator checks if brackets are bold, which directly verifies the instruction requirement
Threshold of 0.8 (80%) provides reasonable partial credit for complex documents with many brackets
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor consideration: Current logic counts individual bracket characters ([, ]) not bracket pairs. This is actually more robust as it handles unpaired brackets and partial formatting correctly.
